name: Ever Enrolled
description: Patients ever enrolled in Care at this facility
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary a
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
  ON mdp.patient_id = a.client_id
WHERE
  mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
  AND a.hiv_enrollment_date <= ':endDate'
;
